cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!B4: Checklist for the DCI Operator before constructing the DCI Management Cluster.
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!D33: For HOST, For CNI, For APPDATA
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!D42: IPMI/BMC (configured via GUI such as iDRAC / iRMC)
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E10: Are the IPMI IP address and GW configured?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E11: Installed on the DCI Management Server and RHEL subscription registered?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E16: Is the DNS server available? (Name resolution / external access possible?)
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E17: Is the NTP server available? (Time synchronization configurable?)
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E18: Are the CDI devices connected and setup completed?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E25: Is the CDI Management Software (Guest OS) started?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E26: Does the hhchk.cfg file exist in the cdiadmin home directory of the CDI Management Software (Guest OS)?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E27: Is the VM created and the client PC running?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E29: Is the cdictl Path configured (symbolic link)?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E30: Is resource group0 configured with cdictl?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E31: Is the user dhrcsystem for the DHRC component created?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E32: Are the IP address and GW configured?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E33: Are the ports targeted for operation from DHRC free of VLAN configuration (including the default VLAN)? (Are VLANs removed?)
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E34: Is LLDP enabled on the connected ports?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E36: Is routing not configured between VLANs of different tenants (NW isolated)?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E37: Is the MAAS server constructed and the MAAS GUI accessible?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E38: Is the RHEL9.6 OS custom image registered in MAAS?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E39: Is the Manager NW (NIC1) Subnet configured / DHCP enabled, and fixed addresses configured with static DHCP leases?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E40: For dynamic IP address assignment, is the DHCP Dynamic reserved range configured?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E41: Is the free pool for VMs configured (excluded from the DHCP reserved range)?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E44: Is PXEboot enabled on the Manager NIC?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E45: Boot order: Is Manager NIC1 first for PXEboot?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E47: Is ping connectivity OK from the operation terminal to all set-up devices?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E48: Is ping connectivity OK from the operation terminal to all set-up devices?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E49: Is external (Internet) connection possible from the Manager NW?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E51: Is no_root_squash configured on the NFS server?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E52: Is MinIO available as backup storage?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E8: Is the terminal (RHEL recommended) operated by the DCI Operator prepared?
cells.DCI Mgmt Cluster Checklist!E9: Are there no hardware errors (CPU, PCI bus errors, etc.)?
